messages:
maria: Postmortem follow-up for last week's cross-region outage. TL;DR: routing policy misroute + backup verification gaps. I want clear owners, timelines, and a plan for recurring drills. I'll list proposed action items below — confirm or reassign.

alex: Happy to own the multi-region routing policy rewrite and canary. I'll draft config and a small migration plan. Targeting 2025-03-20 for a PR. @jin can you validate on staging once I have the patch?

jin: Yep, I can validate. I'll schedule two staging failover runs next Tue/Wed (2025-03-11/12) and collect metrics. Need the exact traffic patterns you want me to replay.

maria: Proposed action items (compact):
1) Routing policy rewrite + canary testing — owner: alex — due: 2025-03-20
2) S3 backups verification & lifecycle audit (ensure versioning + replication) — owner: ravi — due: 2025-03-18
3) Restore runbook edits + checklist (include DB replica steps + TTLs) — owner: sam — due: 2025-03-16
4) DR drills cadence: tabletop + 2 automated failovers per quarter — owner: jin — first drill (tabletop): 2025-03-05, automated: 2025-03-11
5) Post-drill evaluation template & RCA checklist — owner: elaine — due: 2025-03-21
Please confirm or propose alternates.

alex: Confirming ownership for #1. Quick test snippet for staging (do NOT run in prod):
```
# staging-only: flip traffic to region-b for 10m
curl -XPOST https://infra-api.internal/redwood/v1/routes/swap -d '{"from":"region-a","to":"region-b","duration":"10m"}'
```
I'll include guardrails and automated rollback in the PR.

ravi: I'll take #2. Initial plan: audit buckets for versioning + replication, run integrity check of last 30 days of backups, and add lifecycle policy to preserve last 7 restores. Target 2025-03-18. Also observed recurring pattern: spikes Mon 03:00 UTC cause cache evictions and KV mismatch errors — looks like weekly job collision. We should add long-term alerting for KV hit-rate drops.

maria: Good catch on the pattern. Add action: alert for KV hit-rate < 85% for 5m. Owner: eng-runtime (alex to coordinate).

sam: I'll update the restore runbook (#3). Will add exact commands: `aws s3api list-object-versions`, checksum validation steps, DB replica promotion commands, and a pre-check checklist for traffic drains. Plan to publish runbook PR by 2025-03-16.

jin: For the drills: propose tabletop first (no infra changes) the week of 2025-03-05 to validate runbooks, then automated failover in staging on 2025-03-11. I'll create a calendar invite + DR drill playbook in Confluence and tag the oncall rotation.

elaine: I'll prepare the post-drill evaluation template and metrics to review: time-to-restore, maximum RTO observed, data-loss window (if any), failed requests during failover, and cost delta. Will post template to the postmortem doc and set up a short survey for participants.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance 2025-03-10 at 02:00 UTC (affects infra-api).

maria: OK locking these in. My follow-ups: create a JIRA epic with subtasks for each item, link runbook PRs back to the postmortem, and schedule the tabletop invite. If any owner needs to reassign, ping me with ETA. :thumbsup:

ravi: Quick note: I'll add a small automated s3 restore test to run weekly against a sandbox bucket so we have early detection of restore regressions.

alex: I'll include the canary routing policy in the Dedicated config and add a dry-run mode. I'll also coordinate with sam on the drain steps.

maria: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the tabletop to finalize the automated drill plan. If anyone has blockers before their due date, DM me.
